diagram_math_checks.evidence: Statement assumes n>=1 and an R-cohomology n-sphere fiber with supplied compatible orientation. Proof 1.1 and the cohomological Serre supplier identify rows q=0,n as H^a(B;R), with top row written H^a(B;R)u. No other fiber rows occur. The picture uses these identifications, without a general tensor-product assertion.

The cohomological Serre supplier has d_r of bidegree (r,1-r). From (a,n), the target is (a+r,n-r+1), hence reaches row 0 exactly for r=n+1 at (a+n+1,0). All earlier differentials vanish by proof 1.1; incoming differentials from above row n vanish as well. Therefore all four drawn page-(n+1) groups still have their E2 identifications, including n=1, when the page is E2.

At a=0 the distinguished top generator maps by d_(n+1) to e(p) in H^(n+1)(B;R). For x in H^a(B;R), total-degree Leibniz in the multiplicative supplier, applied to x*u with d(x)=0, yields d(xu)=(-1)^a x cup e(p), precisely proof 2.1 and equation (2). No unsiged cup label replaces the actual page differential.
